validation: Remaining 1794 previously observed reports; not an independent blind test
prf_scope: Rerank original top50 using each file's original best chunk; q'=(1-beta)*q+beta*mean(top-k best-chunk vectors), L2 normalized. No full-corpus second retrieval; explicitly a constrained PRF experiment.
anchor_scope: Only original report body and before-fix source definitions. IDF independently computed within each fixed A-only depth. No B, generated hypotheses, patches, or labels as features.
selection_rule: For each family select maximum development MAP, ties by method name. Adoptable only if development MAP gain>=0.005, MRR/Hit10/Hit50/Recall50 do not decrease. Freeze each family winner and global eligible winner before validation. Negative family winners are still evaluated as diagnostics.
combination_rule: Predeclared max_top3_w0.25 and length_p0.005 combined with each anchor weight/depth; pool is top-depth of modified scores. Treat as a separate family. Freeze all choices before reading validation results.
statistics: 5000 paired project-stratified bootstrap/sign randomizations, Holm across every frozen family and primary metric; project macro, leave-one-project-out, repeated development splits and duplicate-query sensitivity
failure_policy: Preserve all source reports and missing labels. A failure is zero; infrastructure/integrity errors stop. No dependence on B success.
default_change: Research artifacts only; preserve frozen current ab_structure_v1 and historical A
